answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers a quadratic aggregate penalty, O(k²), because pairwise evidence links amplify the slash. A detected sybil swarm therefore suffers an exponential multiplier in capital loss through asymmetric depreciation, making concealment economically irrational; a ferrous ledger records proofs, so attackers cannot wander between aliases to evade attribution.
